name: smwmusic-equinox-tori
title: Equinox - Tori
description:
Part of RednGreen's C3 music pack.

Could I ever take part in a C3 [2014] without bringing something by Tim Follin? This one took quite a lot of time - since it has no actual rhythm, identifying when to play certain notes was pretty hard (e.g.: the water drops).

[included are two versions - the only difference between them is boosted volume for the quieter sections]
